description: Looking for an honest Cityscape Apartments Reviews in Houston? Read real takes covering amenities, management, and safety.
excerpt: Cityscape Apartments in Houston, TX boasts a modern look and a promising 3.9-star rating on Google. Located at 13351 Cityscape Ave, it attracts renters with promises of resort-style living, upscale amenities, and friendly staff. But does it live up to expectations? content:
Cityscape Apartments in Houston, TX boasts a modern look and a promising 3.9-star rating on Google. Located at 13351 Cityscape Ave, it attracts renters with promises of resort-style living, upscale amenities, and friendly staff. But does it live up to expectations? We reviewed Cityscape Apartments Google reviews to give you an honest breakdown of what residents are actually saying.

Disclaimer: The information shared in this article was collected from publicly available Cityscape Apartments Google reviews. All opinions reflect the personal experiences of past or current residents. The overall rating of 3.9 was current at the time of publishing.

Welcome to Elevated Living at Cityscape Apartments

Cityscape Apartments isn’t just another housing option—it’s a modern retreat in the heart of Houston. Offering thoughtfully designed one- and two-bedroom floor plans, each unit comes with luxury finishes like granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, walk-in closets, and in-unit washers and dryers. The community is pet-friendly and features amenities like a dog park, pet washing station, billiards room, resort-style swimming pool, and a state-of-the-art fitness center.

Cityscape also offers an Essential Housing Program for households earning at or below $75,680, helping middle-income earners and essential workers access affordable, high-quality housing. This program ensures residents can enjoy the same elevated lifestyle without financial strain.

With easy access to major freeways and close proximity to the Texas Medical Center, Downtown Houston, Central Market, and Highland Village, Cityscape Apartments places you at the center of convenience.

The Good Reviews: What Residents Love About Cityscape Apartments

1. Friendly and Helpful Staff

Many reviewers highlight the professionalism and warmth of the staff. Leasing agents like Ms. Keisha and Candace were specifically praised for going above and beyond during the move-in process. Their approachability and responsiveness left a lasting impression. Residents appreciated how staff made them feel welcomed from the moment they walked into the leasing office, often noting that employees took extra time to explain procedures, answer questions, and ensure a smooth transition.

Even after move-in, the continued support and open communication made a significant difference in tenant satisfaction. This level of attentiveness contributed to a strong sense of community and trust between management and residents, setting Cityscape Apartments apart from other properties.

“Ms Keisha went above and beyond for my family, and she still is, even after we moved in.”

— 5 stars

“Candace was a great leasing agent and prompt with questions I had regarding the application process.”

— 5 stars

2. Prompt and Reliable Maintenance

A number of tenants appreciated the maintenance team’s efficiency. One resident shared that an issue over the weekend was resolved within five minutes. That level of responsiveness builds trust among renters.

“Maintenance came out in less than 5 minutes and fixed it.”

— 5 stars

3. Well-Maintained Amenities

Positive experiences were also linked to the amenities. Residents noted the resort-like feel of the property and praised its upkeep. Those who enjoy communal spaces like pools and gyms expressed excitement. Several Cityscape Apartments reviews mention that the pool area is not only well-kept but serves as a great social hub during warmer months.

Others appreciated the fitness center, highlighting that it was spacious, modern, and clean—an ideal place for maintaining an active lifestyle without the need for an external gym membership. The business center and clubhouse also received favorable mentions for their utility and aesthetics, giving residents functional spaces for work or social gatherings. For pet owners, features like the dog park and pet washing station added an extra layer of convenience, making Cityscape feel more inclusive and thoughtfully planned for a variety of lifestyles.

“It has all the amenities I need and the staff takes care of all maintenance promptly.”

— 5 stars

4. Smooth Move-In Experiences

Moving from out of state can be stressful, but Cityscape Apartments seems to have eased that burden for some renters. Personalized attention helped make transitions smoother. Several residents described a seamless leasing and move-in process, with leasing agents providing timely updates, clear communication, and extra support. One tenant shared that their leasing agent even took time outside of office hours to assist with paperwork and planning.

Virtual tours and guidance helped prospective tenants feel confident about renting sight-unseen. This level of service helped residents feel welcomed and valued, contributing to a positive first impression of the community.

“It seemed like it would be stressful to find an apartment virtually, but with her help I was able to plan everything out accordingly.”

— 5 stars

5. Proactive Management (Sometimes)

Some residents noticed an improvement with the arrival of new management and expressed hope for continued progress. Several Cityscape Apartments reviews highlighted new staff members, such as the current property manager, for taking initiative in keeping residents informed and addressing issues more quickly. Events hosted by management and increased visibility of the team around the property were also seen as positive developments.

However, this praise was not universal—while a few tenants have acknowledged a more responsive and professional approach, others remained skeptical due to past inconsistencies and unresolved concerns. The perception of management seems to hinge heavily on individual experiences, indicating a need for more consistent and transparent communication across the board.

“New manager is definitely making sure apartments stay well maintained and keeps tenants informed of what’s going on.”

— 5 stars

The Bad Reviews: What Residents Think Needs Improvement

1. Security Concerns

One of the most common complaints was the lack of effective security. Multiple reviewers mentioned open gates, theft, and even gunpoint robberies, making safety a major concern. Residents expressed frustration that, despite the advertised gated access and on-site security, incidents continue to occur with little visible intervention. Many feel the gates are left open too frequently, allowing non-residents to enter freely, leading to car break-ins, stolen items, and suspicious activity.

Some renters also noted that security personnel are either absent or ineffective, and their concerns are often met with a lack of urgency from the leasing office. This perceived gap between advertised safety and actual experience has left some residents feeling unsafe and vulnerable in their own community.

“There has been so many gun point robberies, car thefts, and car break-ins and the leasing office is literally doing nothing.”

— 1 star

2. Weed Smell and Public Smoking

The recurring issue of marijuana odor in stairwells and hallways significantly impacted residents’ quality of life. Several tenants described the smell as pervasive, especially in shared spaces such as stairwells and corridors. These complaints often referenced a lack of enforcement or accountability from management, with some residents saying that management acknowledged the issue but claimed there was little they could do. This has led to frustration among residents who expected a cleaner and more controlled environment in a gated community.

For families or individuals sensitive to strong odors or with children, this has become a significant quality-of-life concern. Some Cityscape Apartments reviews also noted that the smell contributed to an overall feeling that the community was becoming less safe and less professionally managed.

“It feels like a ghetto inside the apartment complex. There’s meadow of weed everywhere.”

— 1 star

“Anthony told me he could not do anything about the weed smoking in the hallways.”

— 1 star

3. Noise and Partying

Some tenants were disturbed by loud parties, even on weekday nights. Management’s inability to regulate noise levels added to the frustration. Several residents noted that gatherings often extended late into the night, disrupting sleep and creating an uncomfortable living environment—especially for those with young children or early work schedules. The noise wasn’t limited to weekends or holidays, making it feel like a regular occurrence.

Some renters reported contacting the leasing office or security but receiving little to no help. This ongoing lack of enforcement has led to the perception that management is either unwilling or unable to implement quiet hours or enforce existing rules, further aggravating tensions between residents and administration.

“Right now on a Monday there’s a party at 9:30 PM. Management states there’s nothing they can do about it.”

— 1 star

4. Pest and Roach Infestations

Cleanliness inside units did not always prevent pest problems. One resident reported recurring roach sightings despite multiple pest control requests. This issue was especially troubling for tenants who maintained high standards of cleanliness and still encountered infestations. Several complaints mentioned that maintenance requests for pest control were either delayed or marked as completed without any visible action being taken.

Some residents expressed concern that the problem may stem from the broader community rather than individual units, indicating that pest control measures need to be more comprehensive. In a few cases, repeated issues led to serious discomfort and the feeling that management was unresponsive or dismissive when concerns were raised. Overall, pest issues have emerged as a significant factor diminishing tenant satisfaction and confidence in property management.

“I have spotted roaches on multiple occasions… requests were marked as complete without being addressed.”

— 2 stars

5. Poor Move-Out Experience

Some reviewers noted overly strict and unfair move-out procedures, including deductions from deposits for cleaning despite personally handling it. In several cases, residents shared that they followed the move-out checklist meticulously, even exceeding expectations by deep-cleaning the apartment themselves.

However, they were still charged cleaning fees due to missing receipts from professional services. One resident highlighted the lack of communication and delays when trying to resolve these issues, stating they had to email the management multiple times with little to no response. This rigid enforcement of move-out policies—despite visible effort and care—left many feeling disrespected and financially penalized. The move-out process, for some, overshadowed what had otherwise been a decent living experience.

“They wanted receipts for professional cleaning… it is plain theft.”

— 1 star

6. Delayed Maintenance and Move-In Issues

In contrast to the positive Cityscape Apartments reviews, some residents experienced delays in appliance repair and internet setup when first moving in. For a few tenants, move-in day was marred by malfunctioning appliances, such as broken refrigerators or stoves, which remained unfixed for weeks due to the absence of on-site maintenance staff.

Others encountered administrative oversights—such as not being informed that internet service had to be arranged through the apartment complex, which wasn’t even installed at the time of their move-in. This caused some residents to go without essential services like Wi-Fi for up to three weeks. These initial delays made the transition into their new homes more stressful and left a lasting impression of disorganization and lack of preparedness by management. While some of these issues were eventually resolved, the slow response time raised concerns about ongoing support and accountability.

“Literally none of my appliances worked properly and I had to wait until they hired a maintenance man.”

— 1 star

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. What types of floor plans are available at Cityscape Apartments?

Cityscape Apartments offers modern one- and two-bedroom floor plans designed to suit a variety of lifestyles. Each unit features upscale finishes including granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and in-unit washers and dryers.

2. What is the Essential Housing Program at Cityscape Apartments?

The Essential Housing Program is designed for households earning at or below $75,680. It provides reduced rental rates to essential workers and middle-income earners, ensuring access to affordable, high-quality apartments in Houston.

3. Are pets allowed at Cityscape Apartments?

Yes, Cityscape is a pet-friendly community. It includes a dog park and a pet washing station for added convenience.

4. What amenities are offered at Cityscape Apartments?

Residents enjoy a wide range of amenities including a state-of-the-art fitness center, resort-style swimming pool, billiards room, clubhouse, business center, gated access, picnic areas, and covered parking.

5. How is the safety and security at Cityscape Apartments?

While the community is gated and advertises on-site security, several residents have raised concerns about open gates, car break-ins, and other security issues. It’s advisable to speak with current tenants and ask management about current security measures during your tour.

Final Thoughts on Cityscape Apartments

Cityscape Apartments is clearly a mixed bag. For some, it provides a peaceful, well-kept home with attentive staff and quality amenities. For others, safety, pest control, and management communication fall short of expectations. However, it’s also worth noting the extensive amenity package offered: a state-of-the-art fitness center, dog park, shimmering pool, clubhouse, business center, and beautiful landscaping all contribute to the community’s upscale appeal.

Additionally, the Essential Housing Program is a valuable initiative aimed at helping essential workers and middle-income earners find affordable homes without compromising on quality. The blend of glowing and critical reviews gives potential tenants a full picture of life at Cityscape Apartments—a place with modern appeal, but not without its concerns.

Contact Houston Apartments to get more information about the property!

Disclaimer: The information shared in this article was collected from publicly available Google reviews. All opinions reflect the personal experiences of past or current residents. The overall rating of 3.9 was current at the time of publishing.

content:
Located at 8820 Westheimer Rd, Houston, TX 77063, 88twenty Apartment Homes combines comfort, convenience, and modern luxury living. With a Google reviews rating of 3.5, 88twenty apartment complex offers a blend of lavish features and community-centered living. Below, we break down real feedback from tenants, highlighting both what they love and what could be improved.

Discover Lavish Features at 88twenty

88twenty Apartment Homes brings elevated living to West Houston. Residents enjoy a variety of high-end amenities and interior features such as:

  • Stainless steel Whirlpool appliances
  • Quartz countertops in kitchens and baths
  • White subway tile backsplashes
  • Gourmet kitchen islands with countertop seating (in select units)
  • Spacious walk-in closets
  • Private balconies, soaking tubs*, and standing showers*
  • Full-size washer/dryer in every unit
  • Designer pendant lighting and oversized natural light windows

Spacious studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom floor plans are available, each thoughtfully designed with open-concept layouts, plank-style wood flooring, and built-in buffets (in select homes).

Pet-friendly and welcoming, the community also boasts beautifully landscaped courtyards and green spaces. 88twenty encourages a community feel with resident events and onsite staff that prioritize your comfort.

The Good Reviews: What Residents Appreciate About 88twenty

Despite some critical feedback, 88twenty earns praise for a range of positive features that enhance day-to-day living:

1. Professional and Responsive Management

Many tenants speak highly of the leasing team, including standout staff members like Stephanie, Breanna, Gabe, and Alicia. The leasing office is often described as warm, welcoming, and helpful throughout the entire leasing journey—from initial tours to move-in day and beyond. One reviewer noted, “From the moment I moved in, they’ve been highly responsive and professional,” emphasizing the consistent communication and follow-up provided by the team.

Others appreciated how staff addressed questions thoroughly, reassured hesitant applicants, and provided clear guidance throughout the process. This level of attentiveness contributes significantly to the overall positive experience at 88twenty, setting it apart from more transactional property management teams.

2. Quick and Friendly Maintenance

Maintenance is a standout feature here. 88twenty residents reviews consistently mention quick turnaround on service requests, noting that the team is not only efficient but also courteous and respectful when entering their homes. One resident shared that a broken A/C unit was fixed within a few hours during the summer, while others highlighted that plumbing and appliance issues were addressed within the same day.

The maintenance team’s attentiveness contributes significantly to the daily comfort of tenants, often exceeding expectations when compared to other apartment communities in the area. Their ability to resolve problems quickly helps reinforce a sense of reliability and professionalism throughout the property.

3. Peaceful Environment and Smart Design

Residents appreciate the quiet ambiance of the community, particularly those living in courtyard-facing units where the tranquil setting creates a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of city life. Despite being situated on busy Westheimer Road, many 88twenty reviews report that sound insulation is surprisingly effective, keeping outside noise at bay. This is especially valued by residents who work from home or have young children.

The smart design extends beyond just peace and quiet—open layouts, large windows for natural light, and functional storage solutions all contribute to a sense of spaciousness. Kitchens, in particular, are a favorite feature among renters. Outfitted with quartz countertops, subway tile backsplashes, and stainless steel appliances, these kitchens cater to avid home cooks and those who enjoy hosting. Whether you’re enjoying a quiet evening or preparing a meal, the layout and design of these apartments aim to enhance your daily living experience.

4. Premium Amenities

88twenty features amenities that enhance everyday life and provide residents with the modern comforts and conveniences they expect from luxury apartment living. The fully equipped fitness center allows residents to maintain their health routines without needing an external gym membership. The resident lounge, which includes a pool table, offers a social space perfect for entertaining friends or unwinding after a long day.

The outdoor swimming pool provides a refreshing retreat during Houston’s hot summers. And the beautifully landscaped courtyards add a touch of serenity to the urban setting. Parking is made easier and more secure with a gated garage, giving peace of mind to residents who value safety. Additionally, a parcel box system and a secured mailroom streamline package deliveries and add an extra layer of convenience for online shoppers.

For pet lovers, the on-site dog walking area and pet-friendly policies make 88twenty an inviting home for furry companions. These amenities are carefully curated to support both comfort and connection within the community, enhancing the lifestyle of every resident.

5. Convenient Location in Uptown Houston

Located in the desirable Uptown area, 88twenty is minutes from the Galleria Mall and top Houston attractions such as the Zoo, Memorial Park, and Arboretum. It offers easy access to major highways, making commutes to business districts a breeze. The community is served by the Houston Independent School District and is just 11 minutes from institutions like Houston Baptist University.

The Bad Reviews: Common Complaints and Red Flags

While 88twenty has many strengths, several reviews point to issues that prospective renters should consider.

1. Noise Complaints and Weak Follow-up

Some residents report problems with upstairs neighbors and barking dogs. In a few cases, the noise reportedly came from staff members themselves. Tenants felt their complaints were either ignored or not taken seriously.

2. Safety Concerns in and Around the Property

Reports of break-ins, vandalism, and safety incidents near the property raise concern for both current and prospective tenants. While the management has made efforts to improve security by posting guards at entrances, several 88twenty reviews describe these measures as more performative than truly effective. One tenant mentioned an incident where residents were advised to shelter in place due to a suspicious armed individual, causing alarm within the community.

Others expressed frustration about recurring vehicle burglaries in the garage and individuals loitering near entrances, particularly given the complex’s proximity to a busy gas station. Though the presence of visible security may deter some criminal activity, many residents believe more proactive strategies. Like improved lighting, stricter access control, and faster incident response—are needed to make them feel genuinely safe in their homes.

3. Maintenance of Shared Spaces

Several tenants mention that hallways smell bad, carpets are stained, and renovations in common areas remain incomplete even after months of reported issues. These ongoing problems affect not only the visual appeal but also the day-to-day living experience, especially for residents in buildings where improvements have been delayed. Some residents expressed concern that the hallways lack proper ventilation and routine cleaning, contributing to unpleasant odors.

Others have experienced frustration with unreliable elevators that are frequently out of service, particularly challenging for tenants with mobility concerns or heavy loads. Garage doors have also been cited as problematic, either not functioning correctly or remaining open for long periods, raising concerns about both convenience and security. These maintenance shortcomings stand in contrast to the otherwise modern interiors of the apartments and may influence a prospective renter’s overall impression of the community.

4. Issues with Move-Out Charges and Admin Fees

At least two 88twenty reviews warn of unexpected costs. One former tenant reported being charged $6,700 in fees post-move-out, calling the charges vague and unjustified. Another prospective tenant stated that the community keeps non-refundable admin fees, even when the application doesn’t proceed.

5. Emergency Communication Gaps

Communication during emergencies or incidents (like flooding or fire alarms) has been inconsistent, leaving tenants feeling unsupported during critical moments.

FAQs About 88twenty Apartments

What types of floor plans are available at 88twenty?

88twenty offers spacious studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment layouts. Each floor plan is designed with open-concept living in mind, featuring high-end finishes such as quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and wood-style flooring.

Are pets allowed at 88twenty Apartments?

Yes! 88twenty is a pet-friendly community. Residents are allowed up to two pets per apartment. Breed restrictions apply, and additional pet fees, deposits, and monthly rent will be charged. Exotic pets are not permitted.

What amenities can residents enjoy at 88twenty?

Residents have access to a variety of upscale amenities, including a fully equipped fitness center, outdoor swimming pool, resident lounge with pool table, dog walking area, secure parking, and a parcel locker system. The community also hosts regular resident events to promote engagement.

Is 88twenty in a good location?

Absolutely. 88twenty is located in the Uptown area of West Houston, near Piney Point Village. It’s close to major highways, business districts, and shopping centers like The Galleria. It’s also near schools, parks, and popular Houston attractions like the Zoo and Memorial Park.

What are common concerns renters have about 88twenty?

Some residents have expressed concerns about noise disturbances, especially from neighboring units and barking dogs. Others mention inconsistent maintenance in common areas, safety concerns related to nearby incidents. And a lack of transparency with move-out charges or administrative fees.

Final Thoughts on 88twenty

88twenty Apartment Homes offers a compelling combination of luxury features, thoughtful layouts, and convenient amenities designed to appeal to modern renters seeking style and comfort in West Houston. With sleek finishes such as quartz countertops, wood-style flooring, and full-size washer/dryers in every unit. These apartments present an upscale living experience supported by a pet-friendly community environment.

title: Charleston at Fannin Station Reviews: Resident Insights
seo_title: Charleston at Fannin Station Reviews: Resident Insights | Houston Apartments
description: Explore real renter reviews on Charleston at Fannin Station in Houston, TX. Discover the pros and cons of living here. Read before you lease!

content:
Tucked just off the new Fannin Railway and minutes from NRG Park, the Houston Museum District, and the Medical Center, Charleston at Fannin Station has quickly positioned itself as a standout in Houston’s luxury apartment scene. With a Google reviews rating of 4.5 stars, Charleston at Fannin Station markets itself as upscale, sophisticated, and detail-driven—and many residents agree. However, as with any multifamily property, real-life experiences can offer a clearer view of what it’s like to actually live there.

We analyzed ten Google reviews to better understand the everyday resident experience. Here’s what renters are really saying about Charleston at Fannin Station.

Disclaimer:

This article is based on 10 Google reviews for Charleston at Fannin Station. Located at 9779 Fannin Rail Way, Houston, TX 77045, with a 4.5-star rating at the time of posting. Reviews reflect the personal experiences of individual renters and may not represent every tenant’s experience. Always tour the property and speak directly with staff before making a rental decision.

The Good Reviews: What Residents Love About Charleston at Fannin Station

Stunning Design & Premium Interiors

Charleston at Fannin Station doesn’t hold back when it comes to style. Offering one- and two-bedroom layouts, penthouse suites, and stand-alone townhomes, residents frequently mention how visually impressive and modern the property is. Floorplans include oversized kitchen islands, granite countertops, 42” soft-close cabinetry, and subway tile backsplashes. All of which create an upscale, magazine-worthy atmosphere.

Tenants have also highlighted the comfort of expansive ceilings (up to 13 feet), natural light from oversized double-paned windows, and features like walk-in closets with wood shelving and front-loading washers and dryers that make day-to-day life more enjoyable.

Resort-Style Amenities That Deliver

Another standout feature is the community’s amenities. From the resort-style pool with semi-private cabanas to a two-level fitness center with Peloton, Precor, and free weights, residents note that these perks enhance the luxury feel of the community. A yoga studio, billiard lounge, internet café, and elegant clubroom with a fireplace also offer comfortable spaces for downtime or socializing.

With 24-hour emergency maintenance, doorstep trash pickup, and mobile concierge systems, many renters say the property truly emphasizes convenience and comfort.

Exceptional Maintenance & Leasing Staff

One of the most consistent themes among positive reviews with Charleston at Fannin Station is praise for the staff—especially leasing and maintenance professionals. Residents frequently mention how welcoming and supportive the team is, with multiple reviewers calling out staff members by name for going above and beyond. The property manager is recognized for her open-door policy and commitment to improving the community. While maintenance staff (notably Miguel) has been called out for prompt service and professionalism.

For many tenants, it’s the staff’s helpfulness that turned a standard leasing experience into a great one—and even convinced some residents to renew their leases.

The Not-So-Great: What Residents Warn About

Despite all the highlights, Charleston at Fannin Station is not without its challenges. A number of reviews reflect frustrations that prospective renters should consider.

Communication Issues & Lease Disputes

While some residents have had positive interactions with management, others reported miscommunication and poor follow-up. Especially around lease terminations, renewals, and billing. A few tenants described situations where they believed agreements had been made verbally or via email. Only to later face unexpected charges or find that prior conversations were dismissed or misinterpreted.

In particularly sensitive situations, such as needing to move due to personal loss or storm damage. Some residents felt that their concerns were handled with a lack of empathy. And were frustrated when solutions were only offered after leaving negative public reviews.

Maintenance Delays for Certain Repairs

Although routine maintenance seems to be responsive, there were complaints about long wait times for specific issues, like broken appliances. In one case, a resident reported going months without a functioning dishwasher despite repeated service requests.

Delays like these appear to be isolated but have caused enough concern that a few residents turned to online reviews after exhausting other options.

Noise, Trash, and Community Conduct

Several Charleston at Fannin Station reviews raised concerns about thin walls, trash left in hallways, and rowdy pool parties. While Charleston offers features like key fob access and parcel lockers. Some residents say building security could be more strictly enforced, particularly in regard to unauthorized guests and general cleanliness.

Additionally, issues such as fire alarms going off at odd hours or pets not being cleaned up after were mentioned as ongoing annoyances that affected daily comfort for certain tenants.

FAQs about Charleston at Fannin Station

What types of apartments are available at Charleston at Fannin Station?

Charleston at Fannin Station offers luxury 1- and 2-bedroom apartments, as well as elite penthouse suites and stand-alone townhomes. Residents can choose from warm or cool interior color schemes and enjoy spacious layouts with granite countertops, oversized kitchen islands, 9’ to 13’ ceilings, and expansive windows for maximum natural light.

Are the amenities as luxurious as advertised?

Yes, many residents speak highly of the property’s resort-style amenities. These include a resort-inspired pool with private cabanas, a two-level health-club-quality gym, yoga studio, billiards lounge, resident social spaces, and an outdoor kitchen with gourmet grills. Multiple tenants mention that these features enhance their lifestyle and give the community a luxurious edge.

How responsive is the staff to maintenance and service requests?

Maintenance is frequently praised, particularly the dedication of individual team members. Most service requests are handled promptly, but some residents have experienced delays—especially with repairs that require third-party involvement. Overall, the maintenance team is seen as one of the community’s strengths.

Is Charleston at Fannin Station pet-friendly?

Yes, the community is pet-friendly and features a spacious on-site dog park. However, some residents have noted concerns about other pet owners not picking up after their animals, which occasionally impacts overall cleanliness.

How is the location and accessibility of the property?

Charleston at Fannin Station offers a prime location in Houston, close to major city attractions like NRG Park, the Medical Center, the Museum District, and Downtown. The property is also just minutes from the Fannin Station Metro Rail. Making it convenient for commuters or residents looking to explore the city without driving.

Final Thoughts: Is Charleston at Fannin Station the Right Fit?

With its modern design, upscale amenities, and a prime location near Houston’s most iconic destinations, Charleston at Fannin Station clearly has a lot to offer. The 4.5-star Google rating reflects strong satisfaction among many residents. Especially those who value resort-style living, luxury interiors, and access to a friendly and professional staff.

That said, prospective renters should go in with eyes open. Some residents have reported frustrations tied to communication, lease policies, or delayed maintenance responses. As with many large communities, experiences vary by unit, staff interaction, and personal expectations.

For renters who prioritize modern aesthetics, lifestyle amenities. And fast access to Houston’s Metro Rail and cultural hubs, Charleston at Fannin Station could be an excellent choice. Just be sure to clarify lease terms, get agreements in writing, and communicate consistently with the leasing team for the best possible experience.

Disclaimer:

This article is based on 10 Google reviews for Charleston at Fannin Station. Located at 9779 Fannin Rail Way, Houston, TX 77045, with a 4.5-star rating at the time of posting. Reviews reflect the personal experiences of individual renters and may not represent every tenant’s experience. Always tour the property and speak directly with staff before making a rental decision.

description: Looking for honest reviews of Briarwood Apartments in Houston, TX? Read our in-depth analysis based on tenant reviews before signing a lease!

content:
Located at 2520 Winrock Blvd, Houston, TX 77057, Briarwood Apartments has an overall Google reviews rating of 3.0 stars. This rating reflects a mix of both positive and negative experiences from past and current tenants. In this article, we will summarize the key points gathered from tenant reviews, highlighting both the good and the bad to give potential renters an honest look at what to expect.

Disclaimer: The information in this article is based on Google reviews from past and current tenants of Briarwood Apartments Houston. The experiences shared reflect personal opinions and may not represent the views of all residents. The overall rating of 3.0 stars is based on Google reviews at the time of writing.

Overview of Briarwood Apartments

Briarwood Apartments is marketed as a charming community offering 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and townhomes in the Galleria area of Houston. The property boasts various amenities, including four sparkling swimming pools, tree-lined surroundings, and spacious floor plans featuring built-in bookshelves, fireplaces, and walk-in closets. The management highlights its prestigious location near Briargrove Elementary and The Galleria, making it convenient for dining, shopping, and public transportation access.

However, while the official website paints a picturesque image of the property, tenant reviews suggest a more complex reality.

Positive Reviews of Briarwood Apartments Houston

While the majority of reviews tend to highlight negative experiences, a few tenants have shared positive aspects of their stay at Briarwood Apartments in Houston:

  • Friendly and Helpful Staff: Some tenants have praised the leasing office staff, particularly mentioning employees like Ms. Ermy, Jesus, and Christina for their professionalism and helpfulness. They appreciate the warm and accommodating approach when they first moved in.
  • Smooth Move-in Process: A tenant noted that their transition into the apartment was seamless, with the office staff making the process as smooth as possible.
  • Improving Management and Maintenance: A recent tenant mentioned that since Jesus started working in the office, response times have improved, and management has been more professional.
  • Community Atmosphere: A few residents mentioned that, at times, the apartment complex fosters a friendly environment where people feel welcomed and valued.
  • Spacious Floor Plans & Features: Some tenants enjoy the apartment layouts, particularly the larger kitchens and living spaces, as well as features like private balconies and fireplaces.

Despite these positive remarks, they are overshadowed by a substantial number of complaints from tenants regarding various aspects of the apartment complex.

Negative Reviews of Briarwood Apartments Houston

Unfortunately, a large portion of reviews detail serious concerns regarding the management, maintenance, safety, and overall living conditions at Briarwood Apartments. Below are the most commonly reported issues:

1. Poor Management and Customer Service

  • Many tenants have described the management team as unresponsive and unprofessional. Some have called them “rude,” “unhelpful,” and even “vindictive,” alleging that they withhold maintenance services as a form of retaliation.
  • The office staff is accused of ignoring phone calls and failing to address tenant concerns in a timely manner.
  • A tenant shared that after living there for years, they were still treated poorly upon moving out, being overcharged for utilities and fees that were not clearly explained.
  • Another review criticized the leasing office for being difficult to reach, stating that they ignore emails and calls like a “bad Tinder date.”

2. Maintenance Issues and Poor Living Conditions

  • Mold and Water Damage: Several tenants reported severe black mold infestations that management attempted to cover up with paint rather than properly addressing the issue.
  • Leaks and Flooding: Multiple complaints mention consistent water leaks, with some causing serious damage to tenants’ belongings.
  • Pest Infestations: Reports of rats, roaches, and even termites falling out of walls were common across multiple reviews. One tenant described how rats chewed through their kitchen.
  • Unresolved Maintenance Requests: Tenants mentioned that maintenance requests often remain unresolved, and the online portal falsely marks them as “completed.”
  • Aging Appliances and Fixtures: Many apartments reportedly come with outdated and malfunctioning appliances, including refrigerators that fail to keep food cold and sinks that leak persistently. Some tenants also mentioned that appliances are “painted over” rather than properly repaired or replaced.

3. Security Concerns

  • The security gate has been described as constantly broken, which has allegedly contributed to increased crime within the complex.
  • Some residents reported incidents of vehicle theft and break-ins, with little to no response from management.
  • Homeless individuals were reportedly using the laundry rooms for shelter, raising concerns about safety.
  • One tenant described witnessing a police chase that ended within the apartment complex, further highlighting security issues.

4. Unfair Move-Out Charges and Billing Issues

  • Several former tenants complained about being overcharged during the move-out process, with unexpected fees deducted from their deposits.
  • A tenant reported being charged for additional months of utilities after they had already moved out.
  • A recurring complaint involves unauthorized charges for renters’ insurance despite tenants providing proof of coverage.

5. General Disrepair of the Property

  • The dumpsters are reportedly always overflowing, leading to unsanitary conditions.
  • Stray cats roam freely, leaving paw prints on tenants’ cars, which has been a point of frustration for some residents.
  • A tenant stated that their garbage disposal regularly pushed up food from neighboring units, creating unpleasant odors.
  • Several residents complained about the outdated condition of their apartments, with broken cabinets and peeling paint being common issues.
  • Despite the advertised “prestigious Galleria location,” some tenants have criticized the neighborhood, mentioning the presence of gangs and frequent police activity near the complex.

Tips for Prospective Renters

If you’re considering moving into Briarwood Apartments, here are a few tips to ensure a better experience:

Tour The Exact Unit

Tour the exact unit before signing a lease. The model apartment may look great, but reviews indicate that actual units may not be in the same condition. Pay close attention to walls, floors, and ceilings for signs of water damage or mold, as these issues have been commonly reported by tenants. Test all appliances, faucets, and light fixtures to ensure they are functional. If possible, visit at different times of the day to observe noise levels and potential security concerns. Take photos and document any existing damage before move-in to avoid disputes when moving out.

Ask About Maintenance Response Times

Ask about maintenance response times and get a clear understanding of how service requests are handled. Speak to current residents about their experiences with repairs, as reviews suggest that response times vary significantly. Find out if maintenance requests are completed in a timely manner or if issues, such as leaks and pest infestations, persist. Ask whether the management provides updates on service requests and if emergency repairs are handled efficiently. Clarify if the apartment complex has a dedicated maintenance team or relies on third-party contractors, which can affect response times.

Verify Security Measures

Verify security measures such as working gates, security cameras, and safety protocols before committing. Many tenants have reported issues with the main entrance gate being broken for extended periods, making it easier for unauthorized individuals to enter the complex. Check if there is a security presence or if management actively addresses tenant safety concerns. Speak with current residents about their experiences with crime and vandalism. Also, confirm if lighting in parking areas and walkways is adequate to ensure safety at night.

Clarify All Move-in And Move-out Fees

Clarify all move-in and move-out fees to avoid unexpected charges. Ask for a detailed breakdown of any deposits, administrative fees, and utility billing processes before signing a lease. Read the lease agreement carefully to understand policies on prorated rent, cleaning fees, and penalties for early termination. Many tenants have reported unexpected deductions from their security deposits, so document your apartment’s condition thoroughly with photos when moving in and out. Request a final walk-through before vacating to address any potential disputes over charges.

Check Online Reviews and Speak with Current Tenants

Check online reviews and speak with current tenants to get firsthand insights into living conditions. Online reviews provide a broad perspective, but direct conversations with current tenants can reveal specific recurring problems. Ask about maintenance response times, security concerns, hidden fees, and overall satisfaction with management. Tenants can also provide insights into noise levels, pest issues, and the true condition of the amenities. Visiting local community forums or social media groups may also offer additional unfiltered feedback from past and present residents.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What amenities does Briarwood Apartments offer?

Briarwood Apartments provides four swimming pools, private patios/balconies, fireplaces, walk-in closets, and on-site laundry facilities. It is also located near The Galleria for convenient shopping and dining.

Are there any security concerns at Briarwood Apartments?

Multiple reviews mention security issues, including a frequently broken entry gate, car thefts, and break-ins. Prospective tenants should assess security measures before committing.

How responsive is the maintenance team?

Tenant experiences with maintenance are mixed. Some residents note improvements, while others report long delays and unresolved issues like leaks, mold, and pest infestations.

Are the apartments in good condition?

Many tenants have reported issues such as outdated appliances, leaks, mold, and pest problems. Some units may require extensive repairs or updates.

What should I consider before signing a lease?

Prospective tenants should verify the actual unit’s condition, clarify fees, and understand the lease terms, particularly regarding move-out charges and utility billing.

Conclusion

Briarwood Apartments Houston presents a mixed bag of experiences/reviews for its residents. While it offers a prime location near The Galleria, spacious floor plans, and a few standout employees in the leasing office, tenant reviews overwhelmingly highlight concerns about management, maintenance, and security.

For prospective tenants, it is crucial to go beyond the appealing marketing materials and investigate the real conditions of the property. Here are some key considerations:

  • Tour the exact unit before signing a lease to avoid surprises.
  • Speak to current residents to gain insight into real living conditions.
  • Clarify lease terms to prevent unexpected move-out charges and fees.
  • Check maintenance responsiveness by asking about service request turnaround times.
  • Assess security concerns by verifying the status of gates, locks, and overall safety measures.

Despite the advertised amenities, such as four swimming pools and tree-lined surroundings, reviews suggest that these features do not necessarily compensate for the underlying issues.

  • Many residents report persistent mold, leaks, and pest infestations.
  • Security concerns such as a broken gate and car thefts have been mentioned repeatedly.
  • While some tenants note improvements in management, feedback remains inconsistent.

Final Verdict

Ultimately, Briarwood Apartments may be suitable for renters who prioritize location and affordability over top-tier maintenance and security. Those considering a lease should weigh the risks carefully and be proactive in ensuring they receive the living conditions they expect. If management addresses these recurring concerns more effectively, Briarwood Apartments could become a more desirable place to live.

Before making a decision, renters are encouraged to research further, ask questions, and compare their options to find the best housing fit for their needs.

Disclaimer: The information in this article is based on Google reviews from past and current tenants of Briarwood Apartments. The experiences shared reflect personal opinions and may not represent the views of all residents. The overall rating of 3.0 stars is based on Google reviews at the time of writing.

content:
Located at 22103 Gosling Rd, Spring, TX 77389, Allora Gosling boasts an overall Google reviews rating of 4.3 stars. This modern apartment community has received a mix of praise and criticism from its residents. To give you an unbiased perspective, we have gathered reviews from renters highlighting both the positive and negative aspects of living at Allora Gosling. Whether you’re considering moving in or just curious about what residents have to say, here’s a breakdown of their experiences.

Disclaimer: This Allora Gosling review is based on renter experiences gathered from Google Reviews at the time of posting. The overall 4.3-star rating reflects the general satisfaction of residents but may change over time. Always visit and speak with the leasing office before making a final decision.

The Good Reviews: Why Residents Love Allora Gosling

1. Exceptional Leasing and Management Staff

Many residents appreciate the helpfulness and professionalism of the leasing office team. Dustin, Josephine, and Gloria have been specifically mentioned in multiple Allora Gosling reviews for their dedication and responsiveness. One renter stated:

“The leasing office team has been incredible. Dustin has been more than helpful, very understanding, and thorough. The application and move-in process was super easy.” – 5 stars

Another resident echoed this sentiment, praising the leasing staff for their welcoming nature:

“The office staff is friendly and always there to answer questions. They made the application and move-in process super easy.” – 5 stars

2. Beautiful Apartments with Luxury Features

Residents are particularly impressed with the spacious layouts and stylish designs of the apartments:

“The interior is beautiful, and the amenities are amazing! I love how there’s a dog wash – never seen that at a complex!” – 5 stars

Each home at Allora Gosling includes luxury wood-vinyl plank flooring, granite countertops, designer tile backsplashes, stainless steel appliances, spacious walk-in closets, and smart locks on entry doors. Additionally, all units come equipped with full-size washers and dryers, making daily living more convenient.

3. Resort-Style Amenities

Beyond the apartments, residents love the high-end amenities, including:

  • A resort-style pool with tanning ledges, grilling stations, and green lawn space for hammocks and games.
  • A state-of-the-art fitness center with cardio and strength training equipment.
  • A resident clubhouse featuring an entertainment kitchen, billiards, and TV.
  • A business center with private conference rooms, work nooks, and a WiFi printer.
  • An on-site dog park and dog wash for pet owners.
  • Controlled-access parking with carports and private garages.
  • Electric vehicle charging stations.

These amenities contribute to the upscale living experience that many renters appreciate.

4. Strong Sense of Community and Safety

The presence of a courtesy officer on-site adds an extra layer of security, making residents feel safer:

“A courtesy officer also lives on site, which I believe is a big deterrent of car break-ins, and as someone who lives alone, it has made me feel safer.” – 5 stars

Additionally, the leasing team organizes regular community events, such as pool parties and barbecues, which help foster a strong neighborhood feel:

“They organize regular events, which are a great way to meet your neighbors and connect with people.” – 5 stars

The Bad Reviews: Areas That Need Improvement for Allora Gosling

1. Poor Noise Insulation

Several residents have complained about excessive noise from upstairs neighbors:

“The neighbor above me makes so much noise every single day. Staying inside for any reason is a nightmare. I turn my TV up very loud, but I still hear the loud dropping of balls or whatever instrument they’re playing with.” – 1 star

Another resident faced similar issues and expressed frustration with management’s response:

“We have attempted to reach out to our neighbors, but unfortunately, they didn’t open the door. We sent emails to the management office, but nobody cares about it.” – 1 star

2. Management and Communication Issues

While some residents praise the leasing office, others have complained about poor communication and lack of responsiveness:

“They do not reply to emails nor answer the phone, but they are sure to send out the rent reminder.” – 1 star

Another one of Allora Gosling reviews pointed out miscommunication regarding charges:

“Took weeks to get ahold of anyone so I could cancel my carport. Then, when I finally did, they said I would get credit, but when rent was due, we did not get credited.” – 3 stars

3. Pest and Maintenance Issues

Some renters have reported delays in pest control services:

“It took weeks to get pest control out when there were at least five dangerous spiders in my hall, including two black widows.” – 3 stars

Additionally, there have been complaints about roaches and ants inside the apartments, with slow response times from management.

4. Parking Problems and Towing Issues

Many residents have expressed frustration over lack of guest parking and frequent towing:

“NO guest parking whatsoever. The tow truck circles the buildings until they find someone to tow. As soon as the guest’s feet touch the stairs, their car is gone, and it costs $350 to get it back.” – 3 stars

Another renter highlighted inadequate parking for residents:

“I get off at 10pm and have to park three or four buildings away from my apartment every single night.” – 1 star

5. Unexpected Fee Increases

Some renters have raised concerns about sudden increases in utility charges:

“Water and sewage base charge has increased by $60 and will continue to increase. The explanation was that the water company needed 12 months to get ‘set up.’” – 1 star

Is Allora Gosling Worth It?

Deciding whether Allora Gosling is the right place to live depends on your priorities. If you value modern apartment designs, high-end amenities, and a strong community feel, then this complex offers plenty of perks. Residents love the luxury wood-vinyl plank flooring, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and full-size washers and dryers in every unit. The resort-style pool, fitness center, business center, and pet-friendly features also enhance the overall living experience.

However, potential downsides include reported issues with noise insulation, slow management responses, and parking limitations. Some residents have also experienced unexpected fee increases and pest control delays. If these concerns are deal-breakers for you, it might be worth considering alternative properties.

Ultimately, Allora Gosling is a great option for those seeking a modern, amenity-rich lifestyle but may not be ideal for individuals who prioritize quiet living and seamless management communication. Before making a decision, visiting the property, speaking with the leasing office, and reading current reviews can help determine if it meets your expectations.

FAQs About Allora Gosling Reviews

What amenities does Allora Gosling offer?

The community offers resort-style amenities, including a pool with tanning ledges, a fitness center, a clubhouse with billiards, a business center, and an on-site dog park with a dog wash station. There is also controlled-access parking with carports and private garages, electric vehicle charging stations, and 24-hour package lockers.

How is the parking situation at Allora Gosling?

While residents have access to controlled-access parking, carports, and private garages, there is no designated guest parking, and towing is strictly enforced. Some resident reviews have reported having to park far from Allora Gosling buildings due to limited space.

Are there any issues with noise at Allora Gosling?

Some residents have complained about poor noise insulation, particularly with upstairs neighbors. If you are sensitive to noise, you may want to request a top-floor unit or visit the complex at different times of the day to assess the noise levels.

How responsive is the management and maintenance team?

Opinions on management are mixed. Some residents praise the leasing office staff for their professionalism and responsiveness, while others have reported slow response times to emails, maintenance requests, and pest control issues.

Does Allora Gosling allow pets?

Yes, the community is pet-friendly and even includes an on-site dog park and a pet wash station, which many residents appreciate. However, it’s best to check with the leasing office for breed restrictions and pet fees.

Is Allora Gosling a safe place to live?

The property has controlled-access entry and a courtesy officer on-site, which many residents feel helps deter crime. However, as with any apartment complex, it’s always a good idea to check crime reports in the area and visit the property at night to assess security.

Have there been any complaints about fees or rent increases?

Some residents have reported unexpected increases in utility charges, particularly with water and sewage fees. It’s recommended to ask the leasing office about potential fee adjustments before signing a lease.

Final Verdict

Allora Gosling is a beautifully designed apartment complex with modern interiors, high-end amenities, and a friendly leasing team. However, there are some drawbacks, including noise complaints, management communication issues, pest problems, parking difficulties, and unexpected fees.

If you’re looking for a luxury apartment with resort-style amenities, Allora Gosling could be a great choice. However, if strong communication, quiet surroundings, and ample parking are your top priorities, you may want to explore other options before making a final decision.

Disclaimer: This Allora Gosling review is based on renter experiences gathered from Google Reviews at the time of posting. The overall 4.3-star rating reflects the general satisfaction of residents but may change over time. Always visit and speak with the leasing office before making a final decision.

content:
When it comes to finding a place to call home in Downtown Houston, Houston House Apartments seems to catch a lot of attention — but not always for the right reasons. With an overall Google rating of 2.7 stars, this property at 1617 Fannin St has earned mixed reviews from renters, both past and present. To help potential tenants make an informed decision, we’ve gathered insights directly from recent Google reviews, highlighting both the positive and negative experiences shared by those who have actually lived at Houston House Apartments.

Disclaimer: This article is based on publicly available Google reviews as of the time of writing. These are personal opinions and experiences of residents and do not reflect the official stance of Houston House Apartments or its management.

The Good: What Residents Appreciate About Houston House Apartments

Despite its low rating, not every review is negative. In fact, a handful of residents have found aspects of Houston House Apartments worth praising. Here’s a breakdown of the positives:

1. Prime Downtown Location

One of the most frequently mentioned perks is the convenient location. Situated in the heart of downtown Houston, the property is just a block away from the Metro Rail station. This makes commuting to the Medical Center or other parts of the city a breeze — a major selling point for renters who rely on public transportation.

“The property is one block away from a Metro Rail station so it is great for those that work in Med Center.” – 3 stars

2. Impressive Views

Another standout feature is the skyline views from the apartments. Several reviewers noted that the views from their terraces are genuinely beautiful, offering sweeping cityscapes that feel quintessentially Houston.

“I like having central air/heat, a dishwasher and a great terrace view.” – 4 stars

3. Spacious Living Rooms

Some residents noted that the floorplans, especially the living rooms, were larger than expected for a downtown apartment. This was particularly appreciated by those who like to entertain or need extra space for work-from-home setups.

“The Floorplan I looked at had a large living room.” – 3 stars

4. Friendly Leasing and Maintenance Staff (Sometimes)

In some cases, renters had positive experiences with the front desk and maintenance team, describing them as friendly and responsive. Maintenance requests were sometimes handled promptly, which was a pleasant surprise for a few residents.

“The people that work in the office and the front desk are friendly and do their best to get things done.” – 4 stars

The Bad Reviews: Major Complaints and Red Flags of Houston House Apartments

Unfortunately, the negative experiences far outweigh the positive, based on recent reviews. Many of the complaints are consistent across multiple tenants, highlighting recurring problems that management has yet to fully address.

1. Roach Infestations

The single most common complaint? Roaches — and lots of them. Multiple reviewers reported severe infestations that made daily life uncomfortable, if not unbearable.

“The ROACHES!!!!!! I cannot express enough how absolutely disgusting and miserable my partner and I are because of the roaches.” – 1 star

“This place is just straight up nasty from the infestation of roaches all the way down to the nasty conditions of the elevator hallways and parking garage.” – 1 star

Despite pest control charges showing up on monthly bills, residents say that roaches seem immune to treatment.

2. Poor Maintenance and Filthy Common Areas

Cleanliness across the property was another recurring grievance. From the elevators to the parking garage to the hallways, reviewers described the building as filthy and poorly maintained. Several mentioned urine, vomit, and trash being left behind without prompt cleaning.

“The common areas are extremely dirty! The parking garage and elevator areas look as if they never had been cleaned before.” – 2 stars

“I’ve walked into pee and vomit-filled elevators.” – 1 star

3. Noise, Parties, and Unruly Neighbors

For residents seeking peace and quiet, Houston House Apartments seems to fall short. Several reviews mentioned ongoing issues with loud neighbors, hallway skateboarding, fights, and even frat-party-style gatherings happening regularly, especially on the 19th floor.

“It feels like frat parties every other day in there.” – 1 star

“Young punks running up and down the hallway banging doors and riding skateboards screaming and yelling.” – 2 stars

4. Security Concerns and Car Break-Ins

Living downtown comes with its risks, but residents expected better security from their building. Many reported frequent car break-ins in the parking garage, along with non-residents sneaking into amenities like the pool and basketball court.

“There were so many strangers that didn’t live in the actual apartment building coming in and out using the pool and basketball court.” – 1 star

“My car was broken into recently along with many others.” – 2 stars

The fact that a Houston Police Department officer lives onsite, rent-free, hasn’t provided much comfort to residents.

5. Broken Amenities and Inconveniences

Several reviewers expressed frustration over outdated amenities and broken elevators, which made everyday tasks — like laundry or moving in/out — unnecessarily stressful. The laundry room was described as tiny, with limited machines for such a large building.

“There is no washer and dryer in any unit except for one floorplan, and the laundromat they have on-site is very small.” – 3 stars

“There were so many times where I had to literally take the stairs from the 17th floor all the way down to the first floor due to the elevators not working!” – 1 star

6. Disorganized and Rude Management

Poor communication from the leasing office was another common theme. Reviewers complained about missed appointments, ignored maintenance requests, and confusing move-out policies that left tenants stuck with unexpected charges.

“Management here should be Q&A and audited!! By far the worst apartment experience I’ve ever had!” – 1 star

“They NEVER answer the phone.” – 1 star

Final Verdict: Should You Move Into Houston House Apartments?

Based on these reviews, Houston House Apartments presents itself as a budget-friendly option in downtown Houston — but it seems to come at the cost of cleanliness, safety, and peace of mind. If you prioritize location, views, and spacious living rooms above all else, you may find some value here. However, if you want a well-maintained, secure, and quiet home, you may want to keep searching.

Before signing a lease, prospective renters should:

  • Tour the property in person and inspect for cleanliness.
  • Ask directly about pest control history in the unit you’re considering.
  • Read your lease thoroughly, especially around move-out policies and additional fees.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) About Houston House Apartments

Where are Houston House Apartments located?

Houston House Apartments are located at 1617 Fannin St, Houston, TX 77002, right in the heart of downtown Houston, Texas.

What is the average Google rating for Houston House Apartments?

As of the time of writing, Houston House Apartments holds an average rating of 2.7 stars on Google, based on numerous tenant reviews.

What are the biggest complaints from residents?

The most common complaints include:
– Severe roach infestations
– Filthy common areas (elevators, hallways, parking garage)
– Frequent car break-ins and security concerns
– Loud neighbors and disruptive hallway behavior
– Unresponsive or rude management team

Are there any positives about living at Houston House Apartments?

Some residents appreciate the central downtown location, skyline views, spacious living rooms, and the proximity to the Metro Rail station.

Does Houston House Apartments have in-unit laundry?

No — the vast majority of units at Houston House Apartments do not have in-unit washers or dryers. There is a small laundry room onsite, but reviewers mention it is limited in size and often crowded.

Final Rating: ⭐ 2.7 / 5

Disclaimer: This summary is based on Houston House Apartments Google reviews available at the time of writing and reflects the personal experiences of past and current residents. Future conditions may change as management responds to feedback.

Aris Market Square, located at 409 Travis St, Houston, TX 77002, stands out as one of the most sought-after apartment complexes in downtown Houston. Whether you’re a young professional, empty nester, or new to the city, Aris Market Square promises a lifestyle of luxury and convenience.

Here’s an in-depth look at the Aris Market Square’s pros and cons, based on Google reviews from residents and visitors.

The Highlights of Aris Market Square

1. Outstanding Staff and Service

One of the most frequently mentioned aspects of life at Aris Market Square is its exceptional staff. Residents highlighted the friendly and helpful concierge team, especially Rothle, who is often described as one of the kindest and most professional individuals they’ve encountered. Leasing agents like Trevon and Tre Oliver have also received high praise for their attentiveness, knowledge, and commitment to making the leasing process stress-free, even for those relocating from out of state.

The maintenance team also garners a positive from Aris Market Square reviews for their swift responses to requests, often completing tasks within hours, regardless of the issue’s size. This level of service ensures residents feel valued and cared for.

2. Modern Amenities and Stunning Design

Aris Market Square boasts a host of luxurious amenities that elevate the living experience. Residents are particularly impressed by:

  • A rooftop pool with breathtaking city views.
  • A state-of-the-art fitness center with ample space and equipment.
  • A dedicated floor for social amenities, including a resident lounge and terrace with a grill.
  • Spacious bathrooms, kitchens, and built-ins, designed for comfort and functionality.

Visitors and residents often remark on the modern and thoughtfully designed apartments, with details like hardwood floors and open layouts enhancing the sense of luxury.

3. Prime Downtown Location

Living in the heart of Houston comes with many perks, and Aris Market Square capitalizes on its prime location. Residents enjoy proximity to Market Square Park, an array of restaurants, and entertainment options. The building’s central location also provides easy access to the MetroRail, making commutes convenient and stress-free.

4. Community and Safety

Residents often describe Aris Market Square as more than just an apartment building—it’s a true community. Regularly hosted events and the staff’s warm demeanor contribute to this sense of belonging. Many reviewers also emphasize the building’s cleanliness and well-maintained common areas, noting that they feel safe and secure in their downtown home.

5. Seamless Leasing and Move-In Process

New residents frequently compliment the seamless leasing process, thanks to the professionalism and attentiveness of the leasing team. Agents like Trevon and Tre Oliver stand out for their willingness to go above and beyond, answering countless questions, providing virtual tours, and offering detailed explanations of floor plans and pricing. Their approachable and helpful nature ensures that even those relocating from out of state feel at ease with their decision.

6. Valet and Parking Convenience

Valet parking is another highly appreciated amenity at Aris Market Square. Residents enjoy the convenience of covered valet parking, which not only makes downtown living more practical but also adds an extra layer of luxury to their daily routines.

7. Apartment Details That Stand Out

The apartments at Aris Market Square are praised for their thoughtful touches that go beyond standard luxury. For instance, the spacious bathtubs have received special mentions from long-term residents, who note their size as a rare and luxurious feature compared to other high-rises in Houston. The layout of the units is designed with functionality and style in mind, ensuring residents feel truly at home.

Areas for Improvement

1. Noise Levels

A few residents noted that living downtown can come with its fair share of ambient noise, particularly on weekends when nearby bars and nightlife are active. While some found this a minor inconvenience, others mentioned that sound machines or earplugs effectively mitigated the issue.

2. Hot Water Issues

One reviewer reported experiencing problems with the hot water in their unit, describing it as inconsistent and insufficient for a comfortable shower. While this issue appears to be isolated, it’s worth noting for those prioritizing seamless functionality in a luxury property.

Resident Testimonials

High Praise for Service

“My husband and I have lived at Aris for almost 4 years and are very sad to leave. The staff, including Rothle, is phenomenal, and the maintenance team addresses requests within hours. This building feels like home, and we’ve loved every moment here.”

A Relocation Made Easy

“As someone moving from out of state, I was anxious about finding the perfect place. Trevon, a leasing agent, made the process seamless, even sending videos of the property to help me make my decision. The amenities and stunning views sealed the deal. I couldn’t be happier with my choice!”

Luxury That Exceeds Expectations

“I’ve lived in other high-rises, but Aris Market Square is on another level. The service, amenities, and sense of community are unparalleled. I love the social spaces, gym, and rooftop pool—my friends are always amazed when they visit.”

FAQs About Aris Market Square

What types of apartments are available at Aris Market Square?

Aris Market Square offers a variety of floor plans, including studio, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and larger units, designed to suit different lifestyles. Each unit features modern finishes, open layouts, and high-quality fixtures.

What amenities are available to residents?

Residents can enjoy a rooftop pool with stunning city views, a state-of-the-art fitness center, a dedicated floor for social amenities (including a lounge and terrace with grills), valet parking, and a concierge service.

Is Aris Market Square pet-friendly?

Yes, Aris Market Square is a pet-friendly community. It offers facilities and features that make living with pets convenient, but it’s recommended to inquire about specific pet policies, including breed and weight restrictions.

How is the location of Aris Market Square?

The property is situated in downtown Houston, providing easy access to Market Square Park, top-rated restaurants, entertainment venues, and the MetroRail. Its central location makes it ideal for professionals and those seeking vibrant city living.

What sets Aris Market Square apart from other luxury apartments in Houston?

Residents often highlight the exceptional service provided by the staff, the thoughtfully designed apartments with unique features (like spacious bathtubs), and the community-focused atmosphere that fosters a sense of belonging.

Final Thoughts

Aris Market Square excels at offering a luxurious downtown living experience, combining modern amenities with exceptional service and a welcoming community. Its prime location makes it ideal for professionals and those seeking a vibrant urban lifestyle. While minor issues such as noise or hot water inconsistencies have been reported, the overwhelmingly positive Aris Market Square reviews highlight the property’s commitment to excellence.

If you’re looking for a sophisticated apartment in Houston, Aris Market Square deserves a spot at the top of your list.

Disclaimer

This review is based on data collected from Aris Market Square Google reviews and reflects the experiences and opinions of residents as of the time of posting. The overall rating of 4.6 stars was accurate at the time of writing but may vary over time.
